name: plenti.com.co
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked.
lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
summary: www.plenti.com.co scores 59 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 41 are at risk, and 38 pass. Fix first: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked.

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 8 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /cambio-de-divisas, /en-us/cambio-de-divisas. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), X Ads (3 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _gcl_au, guest_id_marketing on twitter.com, guest_id_ads…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 22 elements on /, /personas/inversionistas, /personas/freelancers, for example .pill-gradiente and .download-app-button-qr. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 27 images are not served as WebP or AVIF
fix.evidence: 67f93ccb76dd8320e112e64e_Inversores fin… on /personas/inversionistas (PNG, 1204 KB), 67f988f1d7859af8f8f30d23_Mujer cambio.p… on /personas/inversionistas (PNG, 982 KB), 6925c8741cf9f04779755b7f_recompensas1.p… on / (PNG, 968 KB),…
fix.fix: Serve WebP or AVIF through the CDN or image service, or with <picture> and a JPEG or PNG fallback.

Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 162 ms
Every external link that was checked answered
